message: 幼馴染みを舐めるな！
I checked my laptop, but there was no trace of Azel putting any new data on it since then.

name: Misa
message: 「What do you suppose that thing yesterday was?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly and Synn-sama were both fast asleep, so we didn't notice a thing!」

name: Misa
message: 「You two are hopeless.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The news said a gas pipe under the park caught fire and exploded.」
This morning, Azel wasn't at the apartment.
Both Sally and Paqy said they didn't notice her leaving.
I have a bad feeling about this.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... wasn't that something else?」

name: Ria
message: 「I sensed magic... or maybe Spirit Power.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it have been Demons fighting each other?」

name: Ria
message: 「Something like that happened just the other day, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura. You had Melilot look into that, didn't you? Haven't you heard anything?」
I check the folder containing the photo data once more.
There's no new data.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura! Are you even listening?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, um... I'm sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「The Holy Night Festival is right around the corner, so pull yourself together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is what they call a daytime lantern, isn't it? It means leaving a lantern lit during the day is wasteful. It's fine nowadays since we have electricity, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「That has nothing to do with the current situation!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? How strange. My sixth sense whispered to me, 'This is the spot!'」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, you're acting weird today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. The one acting weird is the President.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakuya-kun acting weird is nothing new.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not what I mean.\s02」
When I asked at the photo shop, they told me Azel had shown up about an hour ago and picked up her finished photos.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get so down. At the very least, it means Azel was still in this town an hour ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess so, but......」

name: Paqy
message: 「She might've come back already.」
I almost asked if he really thought so, but I stopped myself.
I realized he was just trying to cheer me up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll get straight to the point. Did something happen?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing really.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Liar. Don't underestimate your childhood friend!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You looked totally spaced out earlier, so I thought something was up and followed you, and then you came out of the photo shop with this weirdly disappointed look on your face.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let me guess--it's about Azel?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did she dump you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... I don't think so. I mean, I haven't even confessed to her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You dumped me and you haven't even confessed to her?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Wh-What did you say?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That voice just now?!」
I spun around to see Shina-oba hiding in the shadow of a utility pole?!

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, this is bad.」

name: Synn
message: 「......And that's everything.」
Here, after running away from Shina-oba, I told them almost everything.
The only things I didn't mention were that I'd been seriously injured, and that Azel had tried to strangle me.
That was all.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...So that's what all that commotion was about.」

name: Synn
message: 「I should've told everyone earlier.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't exactly have the time for that, did you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's true, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, you would've had to tell them you're the Demon Lord too, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you still scared?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was scared... but talking to you gave me courage, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you're gonna tell everyone else too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa will probably say something like, 'Demon Lord, fight me!'」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope that's all it takes.\s01」
Nanaka stared intently at my face.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... you, the Demon Lord, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for hiding it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to apologize. I'd hide it too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though I probably would've told you, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just kidding, just kidding. I probably wouldn't have told anyone either. I'd be too scared of how they'd react.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't actually believe him, do ya, Soba.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's hard to believe, sure, but I can tell Synn isn't lying.」
Childhood friends are a blessing.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No problem at all, we do go way back, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think Azel left because she found out I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If that were true, she wouldn't be sitting by your bedside--she'd have run away.」

name: Synn
message: 「You... think so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I think it was one of the triggers. Oh, not because she's scared of you being the Demon Lord or because she hates you or anything like that, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, obviously because Azel loves you. No doubt about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I wonder about that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen here. You're the boy I fell for, so have a little confidence.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Makes me a little jealous, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I'd been the one by your side, do you think you could've become the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」
I tried to answer that I could have, yet something inside my heart held me back.
Nanaka gave a slightly lonely smile.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess you wouldn't go on late-night walks with me anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it'll be fine. Azel's gonna come back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After all, she doesn't have anywhere else to go back to, right?」
